newsitem.title: UK: Courtaulds up, but some pundits cut forecast.
newsitem.headline: Courtaulds up, but some pundits cut forecast.

text.p: Shares in chemicals group Courtaulds Plc rose seven pence to 383-1/2 pence even though some analyst cut their profit forecasts following the firm's latest trading updata.

Jeremy Chantry at Kleinwort Benson said he trimmed his estimate for the current financial year to 134 million stg from 140 million after Courtaulds said its results felt the negative impact of the persistent strength of the pound.
But Colin Isaac at Credit Lyonnais Laing said he left his estimate unchanged, saying it was already at the low end of the market range.
Isaac said shares in Courtaulds were lifted by news the firm would cut capacity at its viscose plant in northern England in a bid to fight market oversupply.
"This is obviously a measure to try and sort out the situation," he said.
